item.title: Brandin Podziemski: Scores 16 points with two stocks
item.description:
Podziemski tallied 16 points (7-11 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 1-2 FT), two rebounds, one assist, one steal and one block over 19 minutes in Tuesday's 124-98 preseason win over the Lakers.

item.title: Darryn Peterson: Scores 23 points with three assists
